query: how do I reset my password
document: To reset your password, open Settings > Account and choose Reset password; a link arrives by email.
A 503 Service Unavailable means the server is overloaded or down for maintenance; retry later.
Two-factor authentication: Settings > Security > Two-factor, then scan the QR code with an authenticator app.
Use File > Export and pick CSV to download every record in the current view.
Billing details live under Account > Billing; edit the address and save.
Slowness usually comes from a full cache: clear it under Settings > Storage, then restart the app.
